population_note_text: Trial Balance rows, grouped by each ledger's own primary group (all TB rows; not filtered to the books population -- a TB row is already a full-year total). Voucher-population figures below use the books population (optional, cancelled and post-dated vouchers excluded) separately.

figures.definition_text: Direct Expenses: sum of TB closing balances under the primary group 'Direct Expenses', no sign flip.
Direct Incomes: sum of TB closing balances under the primary group 'Direct Incomes', sign-flipped to a positive figure.
Exported vouchers excluded from the books population (vouchers exported less vouchers in the books population).
Books population: exported vouchers with status regular (optional, cancelled and post-dated excluded).
Indirect Expenses: sum of TB closing balances under the primary group 'Indirect Expenses', no sign flip.
Indirect Incomes: sum of TB closing balances under the primary group 'Indirect Incomes', sign-flipped to a positive figure.
Purchase Accounts: sum of TB closing balances under the primary group 'Purchase Accounts' (debit-balance group, no sign flip).

figures.value: not performed: no report part in this read
figures.definition_text: Whether net profit and closing stock were tied to Tally's own Profit & Loss report: 'performed' and which of the two, when the report's totals were supplied (from the read's report part), else 'not performed' and why.
Sales Accounts: sum of TB closing balances of every ledger under the primary group 'Sales Accounts' (Dr+/Cr- convention; credit-balance group, sign-flipped to a positive revenue figure).

findings.title_text: Report tie not performed on net profit: the stock is not known, so no gross profit or net profit was derived
limits_text: The gross profit ratio uses the stock items' values: opening stock as at the books' first day and closing stock from the Stock Summary dated the last day of the period, at the costing method Tally applies, which was not read.
Stock is Tally's own valuation of the stock items, not an independently counted or valued physical stock figure; the books cannot show whether it was actually verified.
A stock item with no value counts as nothing, so a Stock Summary whose items all lack a closing value shows a closing stock of zero; a Summary that lists no item at all is not taken as zero.
Opening stock is held on the stock items, not on a ledger, and was not read; no gross profit or net profit is shown.
Closing stock is held on the stock items, not on a ledger, and was not read; no gross profit or net profit is shown.
